name: lafan1_long_walk_segments_v02
heading_convention: One fixed world-Z rotation per clip aligns initial root local +X with world +X; relative heading changes are preserved.

clips.name: idle_neutral_standing
clips.selection_note: Use the already validated upright zero-coordinate pose of skeleton17_collision as the clean static reference.

clips.name: stand_start_pause_restart_walk1_subject2
clips.selection_note: Natural standing, first start, brief pause, and second start in one 7.57s composite clip; turning is present, so this is not a straight-start example.

clips.name: walk_pause_restart_walk2_subject3
clips.selection_note: Continuous approach, deceleration, about 1.93s upright pause, then restart with a pronounced turn; label as a composite transition.

clips.name: walk_to_stop_walk3_subject2
clips.selection_note: About 1.8s of deceleration followed by about 3.1s of upright standing; high-confidence walk-to-stop transition.

clips.name: stand_to_turn_start_walk3_subject2
clips.selection_note: About 3.1s upright at rest followed by a walking start and pronounced turn; use as a combined start-and-turn example.

clips.name: long_forward_walk2_subject4_a
clips.selection_note: About 5.33s of nearly straight forward walking at about 0.72m/s; expands the existing short forward interval.

clips.name: long_forward_walk2_subject4_b
clips.selection_note: About 5.50s of nearly straight forward walking at about 0.63m/s, ending before the next turn.

clips.name: long_forward_walk3_subject4
clips.selection_note: About 8s of upright, nearly straight continuous forward walking at about 0.84m/s.

clips.name: long_backward_walk3_subject4
clips.selection_note: About 6s of mostly straight backward walking at about 0.71m/s; modest heading and path drift.
